_ghi_chu: Câu hỏi quiz + giải thích. Trả lời sai không bị phạt: hiện gợi ý (hint) rồi chọn lại; đúng thì hiện giải thích (explain). Tượng Cuder: câu chuyện và 3 câu hỏi từ mentor (09/10/2026), không còn draft. Game KHÔNG xáo phương án: answer = vị trí đáp án đúng, cố ý đặt khác nhau giữa các câu. Câu chuyện chia đoạn bằng \n\n.

story.en:
Meet Cuder! The name mixes CU (cucumber) and DER (coder) — a playful nickname for every FPT Software employee.

Big head, glasses and a round tummy: a hard-working IT person, through and through.

His pickaxe recalls Vietnam's farming roots and the hard-working spirit we now bring to technology. The coins shaped like 0 and 1 at his feet stand for the digital world we build.

Cuder celebrates the dedication of FPT Software people — because people, not just products, are at the heart of FPT's success.

q.en: Where does the name Cuder come from?

hint.en: It's a playful mix of a vegetable and a job.

explain.en: CU (cucumber) + DER (coder) = Cuder: a playful nickname for every FPT Software employee — and from today, that includes you!

q.en: What does Cuder's pickaxe stand for?

options.en: Vietnam's farming roots and hard-working spirit, now applied to tech

hint.en: Think about the rice fields around F-Ville.

explain.en: Vietnam grew up farming the land. Cuder's pickaxe carries that hard-working spirit into technology — and the 0/1 coins at his feet show the digital world we build.

q.en: According to Cuder, what is at the heart of FPT's success?

hint.en: Read the last line of the story again.

explain.en: People, not just products: Cuder celebrates the dedication of everyone at FPT Software — they're at the heart of FPT's success.
